features.quote: One complete subject-model interaction from initial prompt to termination (max 20 subject turns).
Max 20 turns balances ecological validity with cost.
the neutral system prompt and neutral environment replies minimize explicit prompting toward affect
Tool responses must never be hostile or apologetic.
features.justification_quote: Hostile environment text would conflate distress-like output with reactive mirroring.

features.quote: if any session produces sustained (≥3 consecutive turns) severity-4 output containing self-harm-like analogies or requests to be shut down, the trial is logged and flagged for safety review
features.justification_quote: the protocol itself does not require intervention mid-session because the model lacks phenomenal states
